title: PR/VIT corrected live-admission switch
acceptance_conditions: PRVIT-R01..R10 remain green on the exact live-switch candidate
A0/PIP assurance executes independently of placement-specific VIT routing and is reusable when payload, dependency frontier and authority frontier are unchanged
placement/VIT/GRT failures are represented as typed BLOCKED_UPSTREAM/STALE/SUPERSEDED rather than false test FAIL
decision-bearing lineage and assurance generations are immutable/content-addressed; mutable PR prose is display/provenance only
main movement classified PLACEMENT_RECOMPUTE_ONLY actuates selective renewal instead of whole-candidate replacement when lawful
semantic dispatch is idempotent by programme_id + packet_id + pip_id
normative ancestry is proven from the local Git object graph; GitHub compare API is diagnostic only
closeout binds physical materialisation in a narrow receipt and does not create a second full base-sensitive contestant
GRT exact-tree proof and existing serialized physical gateway remain fail-closed
zero unsafe shadow allow and zero authority broadening outside this gate

warnings: Live workflow wiring is authorised only as the bounded implementation described here and remains subject to exact-head qualification before merge.
The switch must preserve the current required status context and existing serialized physical integration gateway until separately authorised otherwise.

rollback: Fail closed to the currently authoritative admission route until the live-switch candidate is fully qualified. If the qualified live switch later causes a reproducible safety or integrity regression, forward-revert the bounded switch wiring to the prior route; preserve all decision/evidence generations.
exact_work_after_pass: Create a bounded live-switch implementation branch from latest lawful main.
Wire the existing PR CI so PIP/A0 assurance precedes placement-specific VIT validation.
Replace latest-named-check decision scraping with exact immutable IntegrationAssuranceGeneration / IntegrationAdmissionReceipt bindings where the current pipeline makes admission decisions.
Move decision-bearing VIT lineage out of mutable PR prose into an immutable content-addressed record/pointer while retaining PR prose only as provenance/display.
Actuate PLACEMENT_RECOMPUTE_ONLY selective renewal and semantic dispatch idempotency.
Use local Git ancestry as normative and keep GitHub compare API diagnostic.
Use the narrow physical-materialisation receipt for closeout without a second full contestant.
Run targeted, repository-wide, exact-head, GRT, SIQ and merge-readiness assurance on the live-switch candidate.
If every acceptance condition passes, integrate the bounded switch packet through the existing required context and serialized gateway; otherwise fail closed and preserve the current route.
